new_posts.rules_check: Every new post: answer-first first paragraph 45-55 words; >= 2 DataTables; 6 FAQs (visible + FAQPage); 4-5 in-body links; links to not-yet-live posts go through PostLink, and every post has >= 3 links to content that is already live on its own publish day; metaTitles 47-53 chars (rendered without suffix when branded > 60); descriptions 150-155 chars; default pillar CTA (/academy, /services/ai-agents) except #13 (industrial training page). AI posts link /services/ai-agents (cost, evals, RAG, vs-chatbot), /services/ai-chatbot-development-india (vs-chatbot, RAG), /ai-development-company-chandigarh (automation), /academy/ai-agents-course (RAG, evals), /industries/healthcare-app-development, /industries/diagnostic-lab-software, /services/ecommerce-development-chandigarh (automation).
new_posts.claims: No new figures. Salary post reuses only the bands already published in the academy hub (fresher roughly ₹2.5–6 lakh, 2–4 yrs ₹5–12 lakh, 5+ yrs ₹12 lakh+), every mention labelled indicative with 'varies… check current job listings'; public sources named generally (Naukri, LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, Glassdoor, AmbitionBox, college placement reports) with warnings that self-reported data is rough; no surveys, no placement stats, no averages; CTC breakup described without rates or tax figures. AI agent cost post reuses only published bands (MVP with AI features ₹10–25 lakh+ / about $12k–30k+ from mvp-development-cost-timeline; complex platform ₹25 lakh–₹1 crore+ / about $30k–120k+ from app-development-cost-india), labelled indicative + 'get a written quote'; running cost shown as a method (tasks × text × steps × current price), no token prices. BCA/MCA post: MCA 'usually two years', teaching 'eligibility such as UGC NET or a PhD… check current rules', no fees. Industrial-training post: no university-specific rules, 'share your college’s requirements… we’ll tell you exactly what we can provide' (existing site wording). Clinics/labs post: AI does not diagnose, interpret results or release reports; DPDP Act 2023 'take advice'. Capability wording reuses existing site claims (pilot 'in weeks rather than months', eval suite from real cases, WhatsApp via approved provider, English/Hindi/Hinglish, Academy run by studio engineers, no job guarantees).
